resources.string: Front Flash Tester
CAMERA HARDWARE TEST
Test your selfie flash
Try Android’s built-in torch control for a front-facing camera. This app does not capture photos or video, does not use root, and sends no data.
Some selfie lights are screen-only and work only during a camera-app capture. This test can toggle a flash unit only if Android exposes it as a torch.
Camera permission
Android requires CAMERA permission to inspect camera metadata and request a torch. This app never opens a camera preview or saves media.
Grant camera access to let Android list camera capabilities and accept a torch request. No photo or video is taken.
Permission is used only for camera metadata and torch control. No preview, photos, video, or network access.
Camera access is needed by Android’s camera service for the front-flash test. The app does not capture or store images.
Camera permission was not granted, so the app cannot query or control a torch. You can grant it from the button below or Android app settings.

Important limitation

This app tests CameraManager.setTorchMode; it cannot force a vendor-only selfie/screen flash. If Android’s HAL rejects the request, use a camera app that supports the device’s selfie-flash flow. Close GCam or other camera apps before testing.
